description: This PHP source file defines the controller class `ViewMyLeaveEntitlementController` for the OrangeHRM system. It manages the presentation logic for viewing an employee's leave entitlements, integrating traits for permissions and authentication, and setting up Vue components for the front end.

classes.name: ViewMyLeaveEntitlementController
classes.description: Controller class extending `ViewLeaveEntitlementController` to handle viewing leave entitlements for the current employee, incorporating permission and authentication traits.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Pre-render hook that initializes a Vue component for leave entitlement view, adds leave type and period properties, and sets permissions for the authenticated employee.
